claim: Patchline links migration shape to conditional replication-lag hazards without pretending to know a deployment topology. The gate drives the real db-semantics CLI over table rewrites, online schema-change adapters, cloud table replacement, and asynchronous mutations; each positive case must name read-replica, CDC, or event-stream risk classes with evidence and obligations, while a metadata-only MySQL 8 add-column control must remain unflagged.
